name: Valkoinen
source:
A hero imprisoned in Valhalla, the divine realm of infinite healing and infinite madness.

In her original world, she fought to stop the invasion of a superpower. She achieved great success, bringing hope not only to her own country but also to neighboring small countries, but after being shot in the head by an enemy sniper, she was buried under the snow and disappeared.
